Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source metabolism table. Join compound_structures on metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_structures.molregno to obtain canonical_smiles. Join molecule_dictionary on metabolism.substrate_record_id = molecule_dictionary.molregno to obtain substrate_compound_name. Join molecule_dictionary as parent on metabolism.drug_record_id = parent.molregno to obtain parent_compound_name. Filter where enzyme_name equals 'CYP2B6'. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name in ascending order. Limit to 200 rows.
